payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes powers of 10 modulo mod, then uses a direct closed-form combinatorial formula to count blocks of each length, without any DP recurrence or state.
payload.rationale: The solution uses arithmetic with precomputed powers to compute block counts combinatorially. Although it lacks explicit DP, the problem's counting nature aligns with dp_counting_combinatorics. No other DP subtype fits: no state machine, no memoization, no 1D/2D DP.
